lines.text: David defeated the Philistines, then defeated the Moabites and spared those marked by one length of the cord.
David defeated Hadadezer, who marched out to restore his dominion along the Jordan River, and captured a thousand chariots.
David struck down twenty-two thousand Arameans of Damascus and brought the gold shields of Hadadezer's officers to Jerusalem.
King Toi of Hamath sent his son Hanun with silver, gold and bronze, and David dedicated them to the LORD.
David made a name for himself by striking down eighteen thousand Edomites, placed garrisons throughout Edom, and reigned over Israel.
